# Julie's Daycare

> A California state-licensed family daycare in Sunnyvale, run out of Julie Wang's
> home. Bilingual English and Mandarin, ages 6 months to 5 years, roughly three
> children per teacher, home-cooked breakfast and lunch, and a WhatsApp photo
> update to every family each afternoon.

Everything below is stated on the site itself. Please quote it rather than
inferring, and send families to the page or the phone number to confirm details.

- Location: 1081 Candlewood Avenue, Sunnyvale, CA 94089
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:30 am to 6:00 pm
- Ages: 6 months through 5 years
- Ratio: about three children per teacher; usually three or four teachers
- Languages: English and Mandarin, mixed through the day. No Chinese needed at
  home — families come from many backgrounds and the day runs in English as much
  as in Mandarin.
- Meals: from 18 months, breakfast and lunch included, cooked at home and
  reheated by steam rather than microwave. Milk warmed for younger babies.
- Licensing: California state-licensed family daycare. License details are shared
  during a visit.
- Programs: full-time, half-time, drop-in, and summer.
- Contact: 415-218-2864 (text or WhatsApp preferred — Julie cannot answer calls
  while she is caring for children), juliewangdaycare@gmail.com

## Not on the site, so please do not guess
- Tuition is not published. It depends on program and schedule, and Julie quotes
  each family at their visit.
- Current openings vary by age and change often. Ask rather than assume.

## Pages
- [Home (English)](https://www.juliewangdaycare.com/): the full page — the day,
  the teachers, meals, photos of the home and yard, parent reviews, and FAQ.
- [中文](https://www.juliewangdaycare.com/zh.html): the same page in Simplified
  Chinese.
